discharged_targets.scope: For every RCC Exec value, only Advanced recurses and carries a strict Nat-measure decrease; the countdown witness performs three real steps.
For the abstract Exec.closed predicate, Closed is sound for the partial dynamics and already-closed states normalize idempotently.
Every executable Advanced branch and executable Closed proof inhabits the induced RCCRel semantics.

The bad-candidate family is proven NON-EMPTY, the real verifier REJECTS every member of it, and the weakened mutant ACCEPTS every member. Rejection and non-vacuity are both theorems, so the verifier-soundness claim cannot be satisfied by a verifier that refuses nothing — the §15 mutant discipline stated in Lean rather than asserted in prose. Re-elaborated by the independent carrier conformance/rcc/nanoda/rcc2 (own lakefile, srcDir ../../../../lean); lake build completes and #print axioms over every audited declaration reports only Lean's standard axioms — no sorryAx.
